_comment: Presentation-only tuning for scripts/ui/playground_hud.gd. Nothing here is read by authority, reward, inventory or progression code. A missing or invalid value falls back to the constant named in playground_hud.gd.
_comment_party_vitals_refresh: Peer-local presentation on all presets: canonical HP/fainted/resting changes always invalidate the five-member HUD cache. The former candidate gate is retired after the actual natural-loss stale-green-row failure; legacy config values are ignored. No authoritative state, roster reveal/cycle, layout, save or transaction changes.

loss_result._comment: P2-110 original natural-loss blind: a brief unbacked outcome reads as exploration. Passive shared-style Fight lost card for canonical lost only; no modal, input, healing, recovery, authority, save or transaction change. Process-only --loss-result-candidate; --loss-result-baseline wins. E tracked candidate ON for this scoped combined loss comparison; batch held from main/READY until original native/blind PASS, restore OFF on failure. Caught, fled and trainer-relay verdict ownership retained.

exploration_roster._comment: The temporary exploration reveal lists owned companions; TEAM n/5 still states the capacity. The combat roster keeps its own presentation. No timer, order or party state changes.

exploration_vitals._comment: Healthy idle vitals remain readable over outdoor scenery. Relevant health, hunger and sprint states retain full opacity.

exploration_hotbar._comment: P2-004 candidate: let scenery show through the persistent Quick items fills. All five bindings, slot dimensions, icons, counts, text outlines and input remain unchanged. Objective and relevant-state backings retain their own contrast treatment. No durable state or authority changes.

toasts._comment: Hold durations in GAME seconds: the HUD advances its own clock by its process delta, so a slow frame (software GL at a fixed capture fps, a hitch) never eats the hold. Fallbacks: HOTBAR_MESSAGE_SECONDS 2.2, REGION_BANNER_SECONDS 3.2.

drowning_cue._comment: UX 8 / F12: shown only while the local human swimmer's swim_state.drowning is true. State word plus recovery action plus a caution shape, amber (UITokens.WARNING), never red. Font sizes are authored at the 1920x1080 canvas; x0.667 at 1280x720 gives 24 px (critical) and 20 px (body). pulse_* drive the amber frame around the health bar and are ignored under reduced motion.
drowning_cue.title: Drowning

new_system_screens._comment: Production controller screens for Altar, stations, gear, research and bounties. Services own rewards and durable state; readability and device acceptance are tracked separately.
